models.name: stg_waybill
models.sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT waybill_id,
         receiver_zip_old AS zip,
         city_id,
         weight_kg
  FROM waybills
  WHERE receiver_zip_old IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT waybill_id, zip, city_id, weight_kg
FROM cleaned

models.name: dwd_delivery_fact
models.sql:
SELECT s.waybill_id,
       s.zip AS receiver_zip,
       z.zone_name,
       s.weight_kg * 1000 AS weight_g
FROM stg_waybill s
JOIN dim_delivery_zone z ON s.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE s.zip LIKE '10%'

models.name: ads_zip_filtered
models.sql:
SELECT receiver_zip,
       zone_name,
       weight_g
FROM dwd_delivery_fact
WHERE receiver_zip IN ('100000', '100001')
